pending.message: Read-only root-cause evidence for W7 Release red: integrated 89d9e385 WorkQueueProjectMigrationPrepare.approvedDisposable rejects a fixture root with GroupWrite or OtherWrite (lines 133-138). Existing Client.Tests WQ10 fixtures in WorkQueueProjectMigrationPrepareTests.fs:55-58 and WorkQueueCanonicalMigrationPrepareTests.fs:64-67 create roots with Directory.CreateDirectory but never chmod them private. Under a permissive umask (e.g. 0002), those temp roots become 0775, so all 23 WQ10 failures are fixture setup/authority, not demonstrated product regressions. For a distinct fresh qualification, run the exact test process with umask 0077 before dotnet (e.g. python3 wrapper calls os.umask(0o077) then subprocess), or make test fixture helpers explicitly set UserRead|UserWrite|UserExecute on Unix; preserve no broad test exclusions and retain exact new artifacts. Original failed job remains reconciled; do not replay. This diagnosis is source-derived; actual historical job umask has not been independently observed, so verify the new environment rather than claim causal certainty.
